pages.title: The Otherworld
pages.text: Hidden from mere human eyes exists another plane of existence, another *dimension* if you will, the $(#ad03fc)Otherworld$().$(br)This world is populated with entities often referred to as $(#ad03fc)Demons$().$(br)

These Demons possess a wide variety of powers and useful skills, and for centuries magicians have sought to summon them for their own gain.$(br)The first step on the journey to successfully summoning such an Entity is to learn how to interact with $()

Demon's Dream is a herb that gives humans the $(#ad03fc)Third Eye$(),$(br)allowing them to see where the $(#ad03fc)Otherworld$() intersects with our own.$(br)Seeds can be found $(bold)by breaking grass$().$(br)$(bold)Consuming$() the grown fruit activates the ability $()

An additional side effect of Demon's Dream, is $(bold)the ability to interact with $(#ad03fc)Otherworld$() materials$().$(br)This is unique to Demon's Dream, other ways to obtain $(#ad03fc)Third Eye$() do not yield this ability.$(br)While under the effect of Demon's $()
Dream you are able to $(bold)harvest$() Otherstone as well as Otherworld trees.$(br)

$(bold)Hint$(): The otherworld materials you obtain by harvesting under the effects of$(#ad03fc)Third Eye$() $(bold)can be obtained more easily using $(item)Spiritfire$()$(). Proceed with the next entry in this book to learn more about spirit fire.$(br)

Multiple Demon's Dream fruits or seeds can be compressed into an essence that is much more potent. It *guarantees* the $(#ad03fc)Third Eye$() and provides it for a longer amount of time, but comes with a lot of (positive and negative) side effects.$()
The essence can be purified in spirit fire (more on that later!) to obtain a version free from all negative side effects, while retaining the positive.$(br)
